data.one_liner: Highly customizable modal progress indicator with fade animation for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a modal progress indicator widget that can be shown or dismissed imperatively via `ProgressHUD.of(context)`. Supports custom indicator widgets, background colors, borders, text messages, and barrier controls.
use_when: You need to block user interaction and show a loading spinner during an asynchronous operation.
You want to display loading text underneath a modal progress indicator.
avoid_when: You prefer a purely declarative state-driven approach rather than imperative `show()` and `dismiss()` calls.
You need non-modal inline loading indicators rather than a full overlay.
strengths: Highly customizable appearance including colors, borders, and text styles.
Supports optional progress text and customizable barrier behavior.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative method calls through context lookup rather than pure state binding.

alternatives.name: loading_animation_widget
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you want various pre-made loading animation widgets instead of a modal HUD overlay.
